children: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi instructed her finance minister on Tuesday to compile an extra budget for the current fiscal year ending in March 2027, economy minister Minoru Kiuchi said.

Kiuchi did not give any details of the size or contents of the extra budget as he spoke to journalists after a meeting of the government's top economic council. There was no immediate comment from the finance minister, Satsuki Katayama.

The Yomiuri newspaper reported last month the government was considering compiling a small extra budget focused on relief spending for reconstruction efforts after disasters such as earthquakes and heavy rain.
